snippet.title: DEMO OUT NOW: DeeSicks | Dice-based Bullet Heaven
snippet.description:
Play the Demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3913890/DeeSicks/ 

Crawl out of your hole: destiny beckons. Out-spam the spammers and out-summon the swarms as you scale beyond the limits of space and time. Begin as an insect in bullet-slop misery and use the power of physics-based dice rolls to ascend as your very own bullet hell boss.
